desc:
Plant Eggs and watch your Eggs grow to the moon! But be careful, lightning can strike at any moment! Don’t get too greedy…

🥚 Buy a Egg from the river 🥚
🌱 Plant it in your plot 🌱
🥚 Watch your Egg grow 🥚
🦖 Hatch crazy Animals 🦖
⚡ Harvest before lightning strikes! ⚡


🎮 Available on PC, Mobile, Tablet, and Console
